relations.description: S-NSSAI IE is included in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message when specific conditions are met.
Inclusion of S-NSSAI IE is guarded by the condition that the PDU session is non-emergency.
Inclusion of S-NSSAI IE is guarded by the condition that UE is not registered for onboarding services in SNPN.
